 Overview: We are looking for an experienced French-speaking Mobile QA Specialist to join our fast-growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of applications and IT systems with business and technical requirements. 
 Key responsibilities: 
Perform functional and technical testing of applications and systems to identify defects, anomalies, and potential risks.
Define and implement appropriate testing strategies, including manual, automated, API, and end-to-end testing.
Create, maintain, and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data.
Design and execute regression and non-regression testing to ensure application stability following changes and releases.
Identify, document, track, and follow up on defects through to resolution.
Review user stories and acceptance criteria to ensure they are complete, testable, and aligned with business requirements.
Collaborate closely with development, production, business, and other testing teams to investigate and resolve issues.
Prepare and maintain test reports, testing documentation, and quality-related deliverables.
Ensure adherence to established testing standards, processes, and quality procedures.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, refinement, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
Contribute to the definition and development of user stories from a quality and testing perspective.
Share knowledge, testing best practices, and lessons learned with other members of the QA/testing team.
Contribute to cross-functional projects that have an impact on the team's operational scope.
 Required experience / qualifications: 
 4+ years of professional experience in software testing/QA. 
 Proven experience testing mobile applications on both iOS and Android. 
Hands-on experience with mobile device farms, particularly Digital AI or similar platforms.
Strong understanding of Agile testing methodologies and practices.
Experience with testing and defect-management tools such as: Jira, Postman / Bruno
Familiarity with recognized testing standards and methodologies, such as ISTQB.
Experience using monitoring, logging, and diagnostic tools for initial issue investigation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
 Fluent French is required. 
 Nice to have: 
ISTQB certification or equivalent testing qualification.
Previous experience in the financial services domain.
Experience working with complex mobile application ecosystems and backend services.
Experience contributing to quality processes within large-scale Agile environments.
